test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following was NOT included in the Pitt's India Act of 1784?

options.text: A committee of six government appointees, known as the Board of Control, was formed
Madras and Bombay presidencies were brought under Bengal presidency
The governance of India was handed over to the Governor General and a council consisting of three members
All the debts of the East India Company were taken over by the British Government of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**All the debts of the East India Company were taken over by the British Government of India**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pitt's India Act of 1784 did not include the provision that the British government took over all the debts of the East India Company.**
 
• While the British government did** assume control over the administration of Indian territories and created a system of governance with the Board of Contro**l and the Governor General in Council, **it did not explicitly take over the East India Company's debt**s.
 
• The Act **was introduced to regulate the affairs of the British East India Company in India** and ensure the proper governance of Indian territories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pitt's India Act 1784:

 
 
• It established an authority in England to supervise the company's affairs. This is known as the Board of Control having 6 members.
 
• Governor-General in the council has more powers over Bombay and Madras Governors in matters related to the War, Revenue and Diplomacy.
 
• In India, the strength of the executive council was reduced from four to three.
 
• The term ‘British possessions in India’ was used for the first time.
